Dependencies can be defined using oneOf (OR) / allOf (AND) object. oneOf - successful if one of the conditions satisfies, allOf - successful if all the conditions satisfies. Refer API specification for dependencies context object syntax and rules. Dependencies context cannot be validated against context schema if dependencies is defined context JSON, because the dependencies JSON structure is dynamically defined for attributes and the not defined in the context schema. Attribute level properties and dependencies properties are mutually exclusive, example - readOnly property can be set either at attribute level or inside dependencies. If both hidden and disallow properties are set inside dependencies or at attribute level, hidden property takes precedence
